title: Quick Fermented Middle Eastern Buckwheat Kibbeh
description: A spicy and comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring buckwheat and fermented flavors, perfect for a vegetarian-friendly meal. This recipe combines the nutty taste of buckwheat with the warmth of spices and the tang of fermentation.
instructions: Soak the buckwheat groats in water overnight, then drain and rinse them.
In a blender or food processor, combine the soaked buckwheat, chopped red onion, minced garlic, spicy pepper paste, sumac, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and blend until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl and stir in the water.
Knead the mixture for about 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it ferment in a warm place for 2 hours.
Shape the fermented mixture into small balls or patties.
Place the kibbeh on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the kibbeh hot with your favorite toppings or sides.
